nodes.label: Modular Monolith Architecture
nodes.rationale: Kept deliberately as one HTTP server, one SPA shell, one permission engine, one document state machine, one PostgreSQL database — not microservices — so the transaction/document/numbering/audit/outbox contract stays intact while the monolith is split only into bounded modules under the composition root.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL 16 is the single source of truth; the memory adapter exists only for regression tests and is never a runtime fallback.

nodes.label: Bounded Module Pattern
nodes.rationale: Monolith split via bounded modules under the composition root, each following dispatch(client, req, url, context) with a shared NO_MATCH sentinel; the composition root keeps transaction boundary, session, CSRF, rate limit, metrics, SSE, and error mapping.

nodes.label: Composition Root 100-line Guard
nodes.rationale: Architecture regression test blocks the composition root above 100 lines and blocks domain routes being written back into the API root, keeping api-postgres.js to cross-cutting concerns only.

nodes.label: Row Level Security (RLS)
nodes.rationale: Baseline v0.29.0 had zero RLS (grep ROW LEVEL SECURITY = 0); blueprint mandates database-level defense-in-depth, rolled out tranche by tranche (P0-V onward) since repository branch checks alone are insufficient.

nodes.label: Field Encryption at Rest
nodes.rationale: Bank account / NIK / salary stored plaintext with masking only in the response; blueprint requires centralized field encryption + key rotation — proven only for TOTP secret so far.

nodes.label: Maker-Checker & Segregation of Duties
nodes.rationale: Separation of duties enforced up to database CHECK constraints so the maker cannot also be the checker/approver (bank accounts, roles, compensation, PO change orders, CAPA issuer-vs-closer).

nodes.label: Go-Live BLOCKED Status
nodes.rationale: Engineering core is strong and passes regression, but go-live is blocked by four open gate groups: unfinished security/UAT addendum + open SEC-UAT-001; predeploy failing visual regression + LAN load after privileged MFA enforcement; inconsistent RLS/field-encryption/optimistic-locking/UI-API parity/release traceability on new capabilities; and human UAT (13 roles, training, reconciliation, restore evidence, Owner sign-off) not yet executed.

nodes.label: H1-03 Purchase Contract Replay Risk
nodes.rationale: UNIQUE (contract_id, purchase_order_id, contract_line_id) does not prevent duplicate release when contract_line_id IS NULL (Postgres treats NULLs as distinct); header-level retry can double consumed_amount, requiring idempotency key + partial unique index or NULLS NOT DISTINCT.

nodes.label: UTC-vs-Local Timezone Flaky Test
nodes.rationale: toISOString() (UTC) compared against Postgres current_date (Asia/Jakarta local) makes tests flake 00:00–07:00 WIB (H-1 date → 0% delivery → wrong performance_hold); same toISOString().slice(0,10) pattern in production code is a latent single-timezone data-integrity risk deferred to P1.

nodes.label: Branch-as-Warehouse Limitation
nodes.rationale: Inventory ledger uses branch as warehouse; migrating to canonical warehouse/location/bin is deferred to P1 because it touches the entire inventory ledger and is unsafe as a single stop-ship session, while opname/MRP scope-hardening stays P0.

nodes.label: Optimistic Locking (version to HTTP 409)
nodes.rationale: version column protects concurrent mutations; a stale update returns HTTP 409 instead of silently overwriting.

nodes.label: Organization Identity Snapshot
nodes.rationale: legal identity, verified accounts, FX and accounting dimensions are copied at document creation so history does not change when master data is later updated.

nodes.label: Official Document HMAC Signature
nodes.rationale: issued documents store a canonical payload and immutable HMAC signature; reprint uses that snapshot rather than master or transaction lines that may change after issuance.

nodes.label: KPI Data Lineage (journal_entries/journal_lines)
nodes.rationale: every cockpit response carries period, scope, refresh time and KPI definition so numbers keep provenance and are not metrics without lineage.

nodes.label: Opening Inventory Reconciliation Warning
nodes.rationale: subledger vs GL inventory gap is a dataset issue (missing approved opening-balance journal), not an engine defect; must be fixed via normal workflow, never by direct balance edit.

nodes.label: FINAL_SIGNOFF.json Gate
nodes.rationale: npm run uat:validate must fail until real operators finish all scenarios, training, reconciliations, issue closure, restore RTO/RPO evidence, and Owner approval for the same release SHA.

nodes.label: Business Partner Golden Record
nodes.rationale: exact NPWP is unified across roles but name/contact matches enter a duplicate queue and are never auto-merged; merge is non-destructive with survivor, decision, reason, actor and lineage.

nodes.label: Scoped Authority Delegation
nodes.rationale: delegation is scoped and capped at 90 days, anti-escalation and SoD-checked, with runtime grant resolution ensuring the delegator still holds the permission.

nodes.label: Modular Monolith / Single Engine
nodes.rationale: modular monolith is kept without microservices; a single engine (shell/router/API/auth/permission/workflow/numbering/document/audit/db/self-test) is preserved and an architecture regression guard prevents the composition root from becoming a monolith again.

nodes.label: VPS Activation Gate (activated last)
nodes.rationale: production boot is blocked without MAT_PRODUCTION_ACTIVATION_ALLOWED=1; VPS/domain go-live (R026) is held until every human gate — LAN-UAT, training, reconciliations, retest, Owner sign-off — is complete.

nodes.label: Permanent Coding Rules (Section 35)
nodes.rationale: forbids duplicate renderers, hidden legacy, hardcoded account/tax/payroll mapping, direct balance edit, deleting posted transactions, approval bypass, secrets in source, and VPS before gate; requires separated modules, service/repository, transaction boundary, idempotency, optimistic lock, audit old/new/reason, org scope, effective-dated config, and versioned calculation snapshots.

nodes.label: Reset Target Classification (OWNER/PRIVILEGED_ADMIN/STANDARD_USER)
nodes.rationale: class is computed from all active/primary role assignments with highest class winning; SEC-UAT-001 root cause was the endpoint checking only the actor's permission/MFA without classifying the target.

nodes.label: Privileged Reset Maker-Checker
nodes.rationale: Owner can only be recovered server-side; administrator reset requires Security Admin/Owner maker plus a different Owner checker with recent MFA and DB+service enforced maker != checker.

nodes.label: One-time Reset Link
nodes.rationale: random token returned once in the URL, stored only as SHA-256 in auth_pending, valid 30 minutes and single-use; address bar cleared via history.replaceState — replaces temporary passwords.

nodes.label: 13 Enterprise Roles
nodes.rationale: System Admin cannot post transactions, Security Admin cannot run finance, Auditor is read/export only — least-privilege separation across executive/platform/control/business/self-service.

nodes.label: Self-Test Runtime Gate (20 controls)
nodes.rationale: only fail/blocked on critical checks close the release gate; reconciliation warnings stay visible with the delta and must be actioned during LAN-UAT and never flipped to pass without correction evidence.

nodes.label: SOP-09 User Access, IAM & Segregation of Duties
nodes.norm_label: sop-09 user access, iam & segregation of duties

nodes.label: Maker-Checker Control
nodes.rationale: A different checker must verify a maker's request so no single person can both create and approve a privileged or financial change.

nodes.label: Emergency Access Override
nodes.rationale: SoD conflicts are blocked except a time-boxed emergency override (max 24 hours) so operations are never fully stalled but exceptions stay bounded and auditable.

nodes.label: Three-Way Match
nodes.rationale: Supplier invoice is matched against PO and goods/service receipt before payment so only received, ordered value is paid.

nodes.label: Self Test Gate
nodes.rationale: A FAIL or BLOCKED self-test status halts release; it verifies partitions, inventory months, and reconciliation are present.

nodes.label: Atomic Symlink Release
nodes.rationale: Releases install via atomic symlink so activation is all-or-nothing and rollback restores the previous code symlink without partial deploys.

nodes.label: Restore Drill on Disposable DB
nodes.rationale: Restore is tested on a disposable database so backups are proven recoverable without touching the active database.

nodes.label: Append-Only Audit Trail
nodes.rationale: Containment isolates endpoints/sessions without deleting the audit trail, preserving evidence during incidents.

nodes.label: Separate Migration Role
nodes.rationale: Schema changes run under a separate migration role while the runtime role keeps minimum privilege and no CREATE schema.

nodes.label: Checksum-Stable Migration
nodes.rationale: Applied migration checksums must never be edited; corrections are made as new migrations to keep history sequential and reproducible.

nodes.label: Immutable Official Document
nodes.rationale: Reprints are labeled COPY and VOID documents cannot be reissued, keeping the original official record immutable.

nodes.label: Idempotent Delivery
nodes.rationale: Delivery keys make email/integration retries idempotent so a retry never produces a second successful delivery.

nodes.label: Owner Sign-off Gate
nodes.rationale: Owner sign-off is granted only after zero critical issues and complete final evidence; production activation follows R026 with a gate-validated signed file.

nodes.label: Blind Count Opname
nodes.rationale: Physical count is done without seeing expected quantity to remove counter bias and surface real variances.

nodes.label: MRP Netting & Idempotent PR Conversion
nodes.rationale: MRP nets on-hand/reserved/safety stock and converts idempotently to PR so duplicate runs do not create duplicate purchase requests.
